summary: Interior Design service — end-to-end tested (backend + frontend). All 15 backend tests passed (public content, public lead create, AI assistant Claude in Romanian, admin auth gate, admin content GET/PUT with persistence, admin leads list/patch, sitemap). Public landing /design-interior renders fully without login (H1, hero, benefits, steps, portfolio, FAQ, SEO article all visible), lead form submission succeeds with Romanian success message, AI assistant widget answers in Romanian. Admin panel /admin/interior-design shows KPIs (4 leads), lists submitted TEST leads, and displays content editor — after adding missing route registration in App.js.

ui_bugs.issue: InteriorDesignAdminPage was imported (line 94) but the route /admin/interior-design was NEVER registered — the admin sidebar link (AdminLayoutMetronic.jsx line 106) pointed to a non-existent route. FIXED by testing agent: added <Route path="/admin/interior-design" element={<InteriorDesignAdminPage />} /> next to other design admin routes.

action_items: Update /app/memory/test_credentials.md — admin@propmanage.io password is actually the SEED_ADMIN_PASSWORD ('1!nasov01ADMIN') from backend/.env, NOT 'Admin123!' as documented. Login with Admin123! returns 401. This has been misleading multiple testing iterations.

critical_code_review_comments: Route registration miss in App.js: 100% preventable bug. The lazy import existed but no <Route> — indicates missing integration between menu (AdminLayoutMetronic) and router (App.js). Consider a lint/test that ensures every menu href in AdminLayoutMetronic has a matching Route.

Password mismatch between memory/test_credentials.md ('Admin123!') and backend/.env (SEED_ADMIN_PASSWORD='1!nasov01ADMIN'). backend/seed.py uses os.environ.get('SEED_ADMIN_PASSWORD', 'Admin123!') as fallback — but env var is set, so real password is the env one. Test credentials doc is stale.

interior_design.py:225 uses `patch: dict = Body(...)` untyped — allows arbitrary payload; safety comes only from the `allowed` allow-list. Consider a Pydantic model for stronger validation and OpenAPI docs.

interior_design.py:167 `session_id` param typed `str = Body(None, embed=True)` — when frontend sends null the FastAPI Body validator with Pydantic v2 may reject; current tests confirm it works, but consider Optional[str]=Body(None).
AI assistant endpoint has no per-IP rate limit — a malicious user could burn Emergent LLM quota. Consider adding rate limiting (already used elsewhere in auth.py).
